measurement.width_noise: independent Gaussian, zero mean, per frame, in pixels (focal length and target width are NOT perturbed)
measurement.R_k: sigma_D,k^2 = (D_k)^2 * [(sigma_f/f)^2 + (sigma_W/W)^2 + (sigma_w/w_k)^2], with D_k the MEASURED distance and w_k the noisy width (units m^2)

kalman.Q(dt): q * [[dt^4/4, dt^3/2, dt^2/2],[dt^3/2, dt^2, dt],[dt^2/2, dt, 1]]  (Gamma*Gamma^T with Gamma=[dt^2/2, dt, 1]^T: white acceleration INCREMENT with variance q per step; q has units (m/s^2)^2)
kalman.q_selection: minimum one-step-ahead innovation RMSE of the forward filter
kalman.smoother: Rauch-Tung-Striebel backward pass, pinv() in the gain; estimate read at the sample nearest t_mark

savitzky_golay.type: generalized (non-uniform) local polynomial, order 2, fitted to the k samples nearest in TIME to the evaluation time (no special endpoint rule: near the ends the window is one-sided)
savitzky_golay.selection: leave-one-out cross-validation on D (RMSE of the held-out sample)

field_informed.sampling: uniform 15 FPS or gaps drawn with replacement from data/gaps_empirical.csv restricted to 0 < gap <= 2 s
